How does rental work ?
For landlords
1. Select your gifts in your profile, set the daily rental price and duration.
2. Specify whether you want the gift to be automatically re-listed for rent when the previous rental ends.
3. Confirm the transaction to send your gift to a smart contract where renters can access it.
4. Renters will not be able to transfer the gift anywhere; they can only connect the smart contract to Fragment and display the gift in their Telegram profile.
For renters
1. Choose a gift on the rental market and pay for it.
2. Your rented gifts will appear on the Rented tab.
How to display the gift in your profile?
Click "Assign to Telegram" and follow the video instructions to connect the smart contract to Fragment and display the gift in your profile.
Still have questions? Ask in support chat
